title: Closeout summary: S04T03 - Add workflow and skill documentation tests
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Workflow docs tests now require exactly one Agent Directives section, required directive guidance markers, and valid workflow references. Installed Codex and Claude skill tests now assert exactly one Agent Directive Handling section. The missing directive section in 27 older workflows was repaired with the standard trusted-directive handling guidance and explicit step ordering.

Close reason: Workflow and skill docs tests now enforce directive-consumption guidance and duplicate-section safety
